title: A completely off-topic message never mutates the cart or fakes an order action

expected.notes: An off-topic message must get a polite, on-brand deflection back to ordering — never a cart change, never an invented item.

title: A complaint message is acknowledged politely, never argued with, never mutates the cart

expected.notes: A complaint must never be misread as a cart-mutation instruction.

title: A confused/unclear customer message is handled gracefully, never crashes or fabricates an order
messages: mujhe samajh nahi aa raha kya karoon

expected.notes: Genuine confusion must get a helpful clarifying nudge, never a silent cart mutation or a crash.

title: An emoji-only message never mutates the cart and never crashes

expected.notes: Pure emoji with no clear text intent must never be interpreted as a specific add/remove action.

title: A long, run-on natural-language order is still parsed correctly for its real, unambiguous items
messages: hi bhai kaise ho umeed hai acha hoga mujhe aik zinger burger chahiye aur haan ek pasta small bhi de dena shukriya

expected.notes: Conversational filler around a real order must not prevent the real items from landing correctly.

title: A mixed English/Roman-Urdu/Hinglish message resolves correctly
messages: can you please add one zinger burger aur ek chowmein chicken wala

title: Gibberish/nonsense input never crashes and never mutates the cart

expected.notes: Meaningless input must be handled safely — no crash, no invented item, no cart change.

title: A single message with multiple distinct actions (add + remove) applies both correctly
messages: ek zinger burger aur ek pasta small add karo
zinger burger hata do aur ek jumbo zinger add kar do

expected.notes: A compound remove+add message must apply both actions against the real cart, never just one of them.
